괜찮아요.forms: casual: 괜찮아 · formal: 괜찮습니다 · question: 괜찮아요?
괜찮아요.m: it's okay, I'm fine; no thanks; not bad
괜찮아요.e: One word, many jobs: 'it's fine', 'no thanks', or 'not bad', depending on tone.
괜찮아요.t: Pronounced [괜차나요]. Also a polite 'no thanks' when offered something.

칠.forms: Sino-Korean · dates, money, minutes, phone numbers, floors (칠 층, 칠월)

바쁘다.x: I'm busy these days because I have a lot of work.

그런데.forms: casual short form: 근데 · starts a sentence
그런데.ex: 이 옷이 예뻐요. 그런데 좀 비싸요.
그런데.x: These clothes are pretty. But they're a bit expensive.
그런데.t: Also used to change the topic: 'By the way…'. In speech it's often shortened to 근데.

사이즈.ex: 이 바지 더 큰 사이즈 있어요?
사이즈.x: Do you have these pants in a bigger size?
사이즈.e: From English 'size'; used mainly for clothes and shoes.

켜지다.m: to turn on, to come on (by itself), to be switched on
켜지다.x: When I went into the room, the light came on automatically.
켜지다.t: Use 켜다 when someone turns it on (불을 켜다), 켜지다 when it comes on (불이 켜지다).

언젠가.forms: 언젠가 + future: 언젠가 가 보고 싶어요
언젠가.x: I want to live in Korea someday.
언젠가.e: From 언제 'when' + -ㄴ가, just like 누군가 'someone' from 누구.

크리스마스.x: I exchanged small gifts with friends on Christmas.
크리스마스.e: From English 'Christmas'; the formal name is 성탄절. In Korea it's more of a couples' holiday.

돌아가시다.x: My grandfather passed away last winter.
돌아가시다.e: Honorific form of 돌아가다 'to go back', as if returning to where one came from.
돌아가시다.t: Use it instead of 죽다 for elders and other people's family; 돌아가세요 can also just mean 'please go back'.

인내심.x: You need patience when you teach children.
인내심.e: Literally 'a heart that endures and bears'.

상대적.x: Housing in this neighborhood is relatively cheap.
상대적.e: Literally 'facing each other' — judged by comparison.
상대적.t: 상대적으로 'relatively' is very common in news and essays.

띠.x: I'm a Dragon. What's your zodiac sign?
띠.e: Native word whose basic meaning is 'band, belt' (허리띠 'waist belt'); after an animal name it marks your birth-year sign: 쥐띠, 소띠, 용띠.
띠.t: Asking 무슨 띠예요? is an indirect way to find out someone's age. Two people 12 years apart share the same animal and are called 띠동갑.

여론 조사.ex: 여론 조사 결과 국민의 60%가 이 정책에 찬성했습니다.
여론 조사.x: According to the poll, 60% of the public supported this policy.
여론 조사.t: 여론 조사 is for public or political polls; 설문 조사 is any questionnaire survey.

우울감.ex: 겨울에는 햇빛이 부족해서 우울감을 느끼는 사람이 많아요.
우울감.x: In winter, many people feel down because there's not enough sunlight.

심지어.forms: 심지어 + clause: A도 하고, 심지어 B까지 해요
심지어.m: even, what's more, to make matters worse
심지어.ex: 그는 바빠서 심지어 밥 먹을 시간도 없어요.
심지어.x: He's so busy he doesn't even have time to eat.
심지어.e: Literally 'going as far as the extreme'.
심지어.t: Often paired with the particles 까지 or 조차/도 on the extreme item.

즉각.forms: 즉각 + action verb: 즉각 대응하다; noun use: 즉각적인
즉각.x: The government responded to the accident immediately.
즉각.t: Pronounced [즉깍]; formal and common in news, while everyday speech prefers 바로 or 당장.

되돌아보다.m: to look back (on), to reflect on
되돌아보다.ex: 연말에 한 해를 되돌아보면서 일기를 썼어요.
되돌아보다.x: At the end of the year, I wrote in my diary, looking back on the year.

엎드리다.m: to lie face down; to bow down
엎드리다.x: The child is lying on his stomach on the bed, reading a book.
엎드리다.e: Related to 엎다 'to turn upside down': your front faces the floor.

미리 보기.ex: 다음 화가 궁금해서 미리 보기를 결제했어요.
미리 보기.x: I wanted to know what happens next, so I paid for early access.
미리 보기.t: On webtoon platforms you pay a small fee to read episodes before their free release; it also means a file or image preview.

권태기.m: a rut, period of boredom (especially in a relationship)
권태기.x: In their third year of marriage, the couple hit a rut.
권태기.e: Literally 'a period of weariness and idleness'.

몰아세우다.m: to corner, to berate, to accuse harshly
몰아세우다.ex: 모두가 실수한 동료를 너무 심하게 몰아세웠어요.
몰아세우다.x: Everyone came down way too hard on the coworker who made a mistake.
몰아세우다.e: 몰다 'to drive' + 세우다 'to make stand': herding someone into a corner.

기필코.m: without fail, no matter what, definitely
기필코.x: I'm going to pass this exam no matter what.
기필코.e: Literally 'set on certainty' — determined, no matter what.
기필코.t: Expresses strong determination, often with -고 말겠다.

무한히.x: They say the universe is infinitely vast.

엎질러진 물.m: what's done is done; no use crying over spilled milk
엎질러진 물.ex: 이미 엎질러진 물이니까 다음에 더 잘하면 돼요.
엎질러진 물.x: What's done is done, so just do better next time.
엎질러진 물.e: Literally 'spilled water' — it can't go back in the cup.

시치미를 떼다.forms: 시치미를 떼요 · 시치미를 뗐어요 · 시치미 떼지 마
시치미를 떼다.m: to play dumb; to pretend not to know
시치미를 떼다.x: My little brother ate the cake and then played dumb.
시치미를 떼다.e: 시치미 was an owner's name tag on a hunting hawk; removing it hid the real owner.
시치미를 떼다.t: 시치미 떼지 마! 'Don't play dumb!' is very common in casual speech.
rel: to act like one didn't hear

임계점.ex: 기후 변화가 임계점을 넘으면 되돌리기 어렵습니다.
임계점.x: Once climate change passes its tipping point, it's hard to reverse.
임계점.e: Literally 'facing-the-boundary point' — originally a physics term.
임계점.t: Pronounced [임계쩜]; used for science and for social tension: 불만이 임계점에 달하다.

인플루언서.ex: 요즘은 인플루언서가 광고 모델로 많이 활동해요.
인플루언서.x: These days influencers often work as advertising models.

직관적.ex: 이 앱은 디자인이 직관적이어서 사용하기 쉬워요.
직관적.x: This app has an intuitive design, so it's easy to use.
직관적.e: Literally 'seeing directly' — grasping something without reasoning it out.

태평성대.m: era of peace and prosperity, golden age
태평성대.x: The era of King Sejong is called a golden age of peace.
태평성대.e: Literally 'great peace under a sage ruler's reign'.

병동.x: My grandmother is staying in the internal medicine ward on the third floor.

대주주.ex: 그 회사의 대주주가 주식을 대량으로 팔았습니다.
대주주.x: The company's major shareholder sold off a large amount of stock.

단체협약.ex: 노사는 오랜 협상 끝에 단체협약을 맺었습니다.
단체협약.x: Labor and management signed a collective agreement after long negotiations.
단체협약.e: 단체 'group' + 협약 'agreement' — the contract that comes out of collective bargaining.
단체협약.t: Common verbs: 단체협약을 맺다 or 체결하다 'to sign a collective agreement.'

입법예고.x: The government gave 40 days' advance notice of the proposed amendment.
입법예고.e: Literally 'announcing a law in advance' so the public can comment.

군비경쟁.ex: 냉전 시대에 미국과 소련은 치열한 군비경쟁을 벌였습니다.
군비경쟁.x: During the Cold War, the U.S. and the Soviet Union waged a fierce arms race.

추호도.forms: 추호도 + negative: 추호도 없다 · 추호도 …지 않다
추호도.x: I did not lie in the slightest.
추호도.e: Literally 'autumn hair' — an animal's fine new fur, so the tiniest bit.
추호도.t: Always paired with a negative: 추호도 의심하지 않아요.

공시적.m: synchronic (looking at one point in time)
공시적.ex: 언어를 공시적으로 연구하면 한 시대의 모습을 알 수 있어요.
공시적.x: Studying a language synchronically shows what it was like in one era.
공시적.e: Literally 'same-time'; it freezes one moment for study.

격화소양.m: an ineffective effort that misses the real problem
격화소양.ex: 근본 원인을 놔두고 대책을 세우는 건 격화소양일 뿐이에요.
격화소양.x: Making plans while ignoring the root cause is like scratching an itch through your boot.
격화소양.e: Literally 'scratching an itch through your boot'.

방약무인.m: acting as if no one else exists, arrogant and inconsiderate
방약무인.x: You shouldn't act as if nobody else is around in public places.
방약무인.e: Literally 'as if no one were beside you'.
